name: Dumal
description: A hardy people, traditionally hailing from the brutal deserts and other fringes of the world.
skills: Put a point in either Athletics or Notice.

name: Erehai
description: A thoughtful culture, known as recluses who do sparing trade with others and instead focus on art and philosophy.
skills: Put a point in either Convince or Expertise.

features.name: Mana Bolt
features.text: As a Main Action, you can make an attack with a Range of 3, 2d6 to hit, dealing 2d6 damage on a hit. This is free to use the first time each encounter, after that it costs 1 Mana.

name: Wildfolk
skills: Put a point in either Athletics or Convince. Put a point in either Notice or Sneak.

name: Sachantha
skills: Put a point in either Athletics or Notice.

features.name: Strategic Planning
features.text: Once per encounter, increase either your Speed by 1 until the end of your turn or an ally's Speed by 1 until the end of their next turn.

name: Gorok
skills: Put a point in either Convince or Sneak.

features.name: First Strike
features.text: The first attack you make each encounter deals +2 dice of damage.

name: Maisen
description: A swamp-dwelling tribe renowned and shunned for their sinister cultural affinity for alchemy.
skills: Put a point in either Expertise or Sneak.

features.name: Blinding Powder
features.text: Once per encounter, choose an adjacent enemy; the next attack against them gets +1 die to hit.
